title: iandunn.net: the full redesign
summary: The site drops its AI-default look entirely and rebuilds as four pages under a dealt design system, with three fact-checked projects, copy rewritten out of its visible formula, and your portraits as the only carried-over visuals. One release at the end; the live site never shows a half-done state.

save: Also commit the plan files on the redesign branch, so each fresh build session can see them

check.verdict: Three fresh reviewers (on Fable, the strongest model here) each read the plan once: ready after fixes. Ten findings, all fixed in the plan; nothing left as your call.
fixed: Phase 1 told the builder to "disarm" the gate — an operation the skill does not have; the gate choreography was rewritten to how the skill actually works.
Home was being built on project data a later phase then deleted; the data rewrite moved into phase 2.
A claimed CI does not exist (its one workflow was deleted in July); phases now verify locally before merging.
About and Writing were two phases paying two cycles for three small files; merged into one.
The full 1,594-file taste-skill kit would have deployed to production; phase 5 now prunes it.
The final cleanup grep would have flagged the new design system's own token; it now targets the old palette and fonts.
Three phases demanded a flawless gate pass while others allowed reasoned waivers; all phases now match.
A done-when required old pages to keep their old look mid-branch, which token replacement makes impossible; restated as accepted mid-branch breakage.

risks: The taste-skill is built for single-page company sites; phase 1 proves its gate works against this multi-page Astro build before any page is rebuilt.
Its rule that contacts use .example addresses conflicts with a real personal site; real handles stay and those check failures are waived, with the brief as the reason.
The dealt palette may clash with the portraits' warm tones; it is re-dealt only on the brief's hard constraints.
Copy is rewritten in Ian's voice during phase 1 — after this page — so phase 1's pull request is the redline point.
Pages not yet rebuilt render broken on the redesign branch mid-build; only the branch sees them.
